s01: Hello again, my friend! (pause) Yesterday, Tala met her new friend Lino. (pause) Today, we learn to share and help!
words: Lino is our friend now. Let us learn how to be kind to him. (pause) Good friends do kind things. (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap each picture and say it with me!
words-1: Share. (pause) When we share, we give some to a friend.
words-2: Help. (pause) When we help, we do something for others.
words-3: Care. (pause) When we care, we are gentle and kind. (pause) Are you okay?
words-4: Take turns. (pause) You go first, then me!
act: You know the words! Now let us move our helping hands. (pause) Stand up! (pause) Let us use our helping hands. (pause) Do it with me, then tap.
act-1: Share! (pause) Hold out your hands and give.
act-2: Help! (pause) Bend down and pick it up.
act-3: Care! (pause) Give yourself a gentle hug.
act-4: Take turns! (pause) Point to a friend. You, then me!
find: Great moving! Now use your ears. (pause) Listen carefully. (pause) Tap the right picture.
s1: You know the kind words. Now let us see them in a story! (pause) Story time! (pause) Our story is, Lino's Crayons. (pause) It is art time. (pause) Lino opens his crayon box. (pause) He wants to draw a big sun.
s2: But then, something happens. (pause) Oh no! (pause) The box falls down. (pause) The crayons roll everywhere. (pause) And the yellow crayon breaks! (pause) Lino is sad.
mid: Lino needs help. What should Tala do? (pause) Quick question! (pause) Lino needs help.
mid-q1: The crayons fell. (pause) What should Tala do?
mid-q1-yes: Yes! A good friend helps. (pause) Let us see what Tala does!
s3: Look who comes to help! (pause) Tala and Bunso come to help. (pause) They pick up all the crayons. (pause) Then Tala shares her yellow crayon. (pause) Here, Lino!
s4: How does the story end? (pause) Lino smiles. (pause) Thank you, Tala! (pause) They take turns with the yellow crayon. (pause) Together, they draw a big, bright sun!
check: Friends help and share! (pause) Let us think about the story.
check-q1: Who helped Lino pick up the crayons?
check-q1-yes: Yes! Tala and Bunso helped Lino.
check-q2: What did Tala share with Lino?
check-q2-yes: Yes! Tala shared her yellow crayon.
check-q3: What did Lino say to Tala?
check-q3-yes: Yes! Lino said, Thank you, Tala! (pause) That is a kind word.
order: Can you remember the whole story? (pause) Tap the pictures in order. (pause) First. (pause) Next. (pause) Last.
order-3: Last, they drew a big sun together.
order-yes: First, next, last! (pause) You told the whole story!
i-can-help: Tala was a helping hand. You can be one too! (pause) How can you be a helping hand? (pause) Tap one. (pause) Then say it with me.
i-can-help-2: I can help pick up toys.
talk: Now say it all by yourself! (pause) Tell me how you help a friend. (pause) Say: I help my friend. I share my crayons. (pause) Your turn!
talk-example: I help my friend. I share my crayons.
verse: Tala helped Lino on a sad day. The Bible tells us why. (pause) Our Bible verse is, (pause) A friend loves at all times. (pause) Lino had a sad day. (pause) Tala still helped him!
verse-verse: A friend loves at all times. (pause) Proverbs seventeen, verse seventeen.
done: What a kind day we had! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You learned four kind words. (pause) You told who helped Lino. (pause) And you said how you help. (pause) Tomorrow, we listen and learn together!
